we all need to wear an eye patch sometime in our lives (but don't forget it causes you to lose your depth perception). it doesn't hurt to do something absolutely outrageous. [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KMj_KWftpBM&feature=related](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KMj_KWftpBM&feature=related)
speaking of great things in life, did you know NIN and Bowie have an album? talk about two great things in life (maybe as good as pb&j?) i've learned so much on this trip!
the sun's out today! did i mention i can't wait to go to the beach? bethie needs some vitamin D. last night i stayed up until 5, drank 1/3 of vodka, slept for 2 hours, then ran for 30 min. do i know how to power through or what? i'll post later after the sari excursion. i'm already annoyed thinking about having tons of faberic drapped across my body trying to eat. that's an accident waiting to happen.
the newspapers out here are awesome; here are some highlights: 'children buried neck-deep in mud to cure them of disabilities', lots of photos of dead people and blood, great commentaries on homosexuality- did you know until recently it was illegal in India?
